communications.subject: Cancellation Request
communications.body:
Hi,

I would like to cancel my subscription with SaaS Platform. Please confirm cancellation and ensure I will not be charged again.

Thank you,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Cancellation Request
communications.body:
Hi Eleanor,

Your cancellation request has been received and processed. Your service will remain active until the end of your current billing period. You will not be charged after that date.

Customer Support
SaaS Platform

communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-940584054
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $8 on my statement from SaaS Platform. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-940584054
communications.body: Merchant responded via email on January 17, 2026, stating that charges may take time to clear and advised monitoring my statement. They did not acknowledge the cancellation proof or offer a refund for the disputed charge, and subsequent follow-ups were ignored. Their response did not resolve the issue.
